title: Rabbi Eliezer ben Chalafta (an Amora)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 27:4, where Rabbi Acha speaks in his name. Kohelet Rabbah 3:15 reads “Rabbi Acha in the name of Rabbi Chalafta.” Hyman considers the correct reading to be as cited in [Tanchuma] Emor 12: “Rabbi Acha in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani.”[^1]

notes.text: The supplied Emor 12 is identified contextually as Tanchuma. The Torat Emet digital Tanchuma Emor 9 has Rabbi Acha reporting Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman on the same Kohelet verse, alongside Hyman’s supplied section 12 and Nachmani form. Vayikra Rabbah — TE 27:4 fully writes Rav Acha, whereas Hyman supplies Rabbi Acha; no claim about print correction history follows.
